source: photocraft-cli commands --json on installed VPS binary

commands.label: Reveal Selection
commands.params: {"layer":id?} (no layer: every selected layer that can take a mask)

commands.label: Color Lookup…
commands.params: {"lut":"none|warm|cool|tealOrange|bleachBypass|fadedFilm|dayForNight|monoContrast|crossProcess"="none","file":text,"interpolation":"trilinear|tetrahedral"="trilinear","dither":bool=false,"data":text,"dataEncoding":"text|base64"="text","fileName":text,"lutFormat":"auto|cube|3dl|look"="auto"} (file: LUT path; data: file text or encoded bytes; lutFormat overrides format detection, auto detects it)

commands.label: Drop Shadow…
commands.params: {"color":"#rrggbb","opacity":0..100=75,"blend":str="multiply","angle":deg=120,"useGlobalLight":bool,"distance":px=5,"spread":0..100,"size":px=5,"contour":"Linear|Cone|Cone - Inverted|Cove - Deep|Cove - Shallow|Gaussian|Half Round|Ring|Ring - Double|Rolling Slope - Descending|Rounded Steps|Sawtooth 1"|{"name":str,"points":[[in 0..1,out 0..1],…],"corners":[bool,…]}="Linear","antiAlias":bool,"noise":0..100,"knocksOut":bool,"add":bool,"layer":id}

commands.label: Free Transform
commands.params: {"layer":id?,"layers":[id,…]? (several layers moved by one box, one step; default with neither = the selected layers, as Photoshop's Free Transform with several selected; refused as locked when the Background is among several),"rect":[x0,y0,x1,y1]? (source frame; default = the layers' content ∩ selection),"quad":[[x,y]×4]? (where the frame's corners go, clockwise from top-left),"matrix":[a,b,c,d,e,f]? (affine alternative),"scaleX":%?,"scaleY":%?,"rotate":deg?,"dx":px?,"dy":px?,"reference":"center|topLeft|top|topRight|left|right|bottomLeft|bottom|bottomRight"|[x,y]="center" (relative alternative: scale and rotate about this point, then move),"interpolation":"bicubic|bilinear|nearest|bicubicSharper|bicubicSmoother|bicubicAutomatic"="bicubic" (Photoshop's bicubic variants render as Bicubic),"stepName":"Transform Path"? (History step name; the shape tools' bounding box sends it; default "Free Transform"; any other value is refused),"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target (an unlinked mask, an alpha channel or the Quick Mask transforms alone; a linked mask moves with its layer)}

commands.label: Object Selection
commands.params: {"rect":[x,y,w,h] | "point":[x,y],"mode":"replace|add|subtract|intersect"="replace","sampleAllLayers":bool=false} (point: the Object Finder's object under the point, as hovering previews it)

commands.label: Subject
commands.params: {"sampleAllLayers":bool=false,"mode":"replace|add|subtract|intersect"="replace"} (samples the selected layer; the composite when no pixel layer is selected)

commands.label: Refine Edge
commands.params: {"radius":px=0,"smartRadius":bool=false,"smooth":0..100=0,"feather":px=0,"contrast":0..100=0,"shiftEdge":-100..100=0,"decontaminate":bool=false,"amount":0..100=100,"output":"selection|layerMask|newLayer|newLayerWithMask|newDocument|newDocumentWithMask"="selection","sampleAllLayers":bool=false,"refineStrokes":[{"points":[[x,y],…],"size":px=30,"mode":"add|subtract"="add"},…]=[],"edits":[{"tool":"quick","points":[[x,y],…],"size":px=30,"mode":"add|subtract"="add","sampleAllLayers":bool=false} | {"tool":"brush","points":[[x,y],…],"size":px=30,"hardness":0..100=100,"mode":"add|subtract"="add"} | {"tool":"lasso","points":[[x,y],…≥3],"mode":"add|subtract"="add"} | {"tool":"object","rect":[x,y,w,h] | "point":[x,y],"mode":"add|subtract"="add","sampleAllLayers":bool=false} | {"tool":"subject","mode":"replace|add|subtract"="replace","sampleAllLayers":bool=true} | {"tool":"clear"} | {"tool":"invert"},…]=[]} (refineStrokes: the Refine Edge Brush, in painting order: add refines the painted area from the image, subtract keeps the original edge there; edits: the workspace's Quick Selection, Brush, Lasso, Object Selection, Select Subject, Clear Selection and Invert, applied in order to the selection before its edge is refined)

commands.label: Canvas Size…
commands.params: {"width":number,"height":number,"units":"px|percent"="px" (percent uses each current side; absolute sizes only),"relative":bool=false,"anchor":"topLeft|top|topRight|left|center|right|bottomLeft|bottom|bottomRight"="center","extensionColor":"background|foreground|white|black|transparent|#rrggbb"="background"}

commands.label: Place Embedded…
commands.params: {"path":str,"scale":%? (default: fit when larger than the canvas),"fit":bool? (default: Preferences > General > Resize Image During Place),"smartObject":bool? (default: Preferences > General > Always Create Smart Objects When Placing),"center":[x,y]?,"approveHighMemory":bool=false (explicitly approve high memory usage),"frame":id|false? (default: selected frame)}

commands.label: Layers to Files…
commands.params: {"dir":folder,"format":"png|jpg|psd|tiff|…"="png","prefix":str=document name,"visibleOnly":bool=true,"trim":bool=false,"quality":0..12?,"jpegFormat":"baseline|optimized|progressive"?,"tiffLayers":bool=false,"tiffCompression":"none|lzw|zip"?,"tiffTransparency":bool?,"tiffPyramid":bool=false,"tgaBits":24|32?,"dpxBits":8|10|12|16? (DPX: bits per sample; unset, 8 for an 8-bit document, else 16),"ddsCompression":"none|bc1|bc2|bc3"="none" (DDS: uncompressed, or block compression; BC1 keeps alpha on or off),"ddsMipmaps":bool=false (DDS: also write the full mip chain),"maximizeCompatibility":bool? (PSD/PSB: write the real merged image; unset, Preferences > File Handling > Maximize PSD and PSB File Compatibility),"pdfSpotPlates":bool=true (PDF: spot channels as overprinting Separation plates after the image; a Multichannel document as plates alone, so false refuses it)} → {files}

commands.label: Warp
commands.params: {"layer":id?,"rect":[x0,y0,x1,y1]? (warp box; default = layer content ∩ selection),"style":"custom|none|arc|arcLower|arcUpper|arch|bulge|shellLower|shellUpper|flag|wave|fish|rise|fisheye|inflate|squeeze|twist|cylinder","bend":%=50,"hDistort":%,"vDistort":%,"vertical":bool,"values":[left,bottom,right,top,topDepth,bottomDepth,wrap]? (cylinder: silhouettes and edges in document px, the ellipses' depths in half-axis units, wrap 0..1; horizontal only),"mesh":{"us":[0,…,1],"vs":[0,…,1],"points":[[x,y]…]} ((3c+1)×(3r+1) control points, row-major, document px; on a smart object `us`/`vs` span the source contents, so points equal to the placement are an identity warp even when it is skewed),"grid":[cols,rows]?,"warp":{full warp object}?,"interpolation":"bicubic|bilinear|nearest"} — on a type layer a style (or none) sets its Warp Text and the type stays editable

commands.label: Perspective Warp
commands.params: {"planes":[{"src":[[x,y]×4],"dst":[[x,y]×4]}…] (corners clockwise from top-left; corners that coincide in src are linked),"straighten":"horizontal|vertical|auto"?,"interpolation":"bicubic|bilinear|nearest","layer":id?}
